title: Day 10: Rent vs. Buy in Austin – Running the Real Numbers
excerpt: This search spikes whenever rates or rents move.
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “rent vs buy Austin TX 2026”, “is it cheaper to rent or buy Austin”, and “break even analysis homeownership Austin” want a local, practical answer.

This search spikes whenever rates or rents move.

The classic calculation (monthly rent vs. full ownership cost including taxes, insurance, maintenance, and opportunity cost of down payment) still applies, but local property taxes and insurance push the ownership side higher than many out-of-state buyers expect.

A realistic model includes 1% of home value annually for maintenance reserves and accounts for the homestead exemption after the first year. For many households the break-even horizon is longer than it was in the low-rate years.

Use current rent comps for similar properties in the same zip code rather than citywide averages.

The answer is household-specific; the search volume shows people want a clear framework, not a universal verdict.
